name: Life spaceship 5a080db3 on square grid
description: A period-4 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the square grid, with touching neighbours, 5 to 5 cells, moving (−1, −1) lattice steps every 4 generations. It runs the same way in the 256 rules from B3/S23 to B3678/S0235678. It also runs in Life, unchanged, on 25 isohedral and drawn tilings with the square grid's neighbour graph. This is Conway's glider, found by Richard Guy in 1970.
